title: First-run setup checklist for administrators, replacing the currency and time zone dialog
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filed on the maintainer's word, verbatim: 「加一个首次配置清单：目前启动时就弹出选择货币很奇怪，一起处理」 (2026-11-05).

From the real-user walkthrough of Setup, on `main` `b7075d9908` unless a line says otherwise.

## What a customer sees

- A new administrator lands on Setup's statistics dashboard, with nothing about what to do first.
- A dialog asks for the time zone and currency on the first screens, before they have done anything that needs a currency. On the published 18.3.0 it opened right after an invitation and covered the toast saying how to share the link.
- Defaults disagree. On the test deployment 默认语言 was 英语(美国) and 默认国家 was 美国, beside CNY and Asia/Taipei, while the console itself showed Chinese.
- Typing 中国 into 默认国家 is refused with an English message, `Default country does not match the expected format…`. Only the exact list value 中国 (CN) saves.
- Every invitee reads the default organization name unless someone knows to rename it (#30125 row 1).

## What exists

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx` and `workspaceTimezonePromptLogic.ts`: an administrator is asked once, from objectui#11693's ruling B2 and #28872. Those rulings have reasons this card keeps: the browser's zone is never written silently, and an unset currency must not go unnoticed. What the maintainer's word changes is the form, a dialog at startup.

## Expected

- A checklist for administrators, on the home page or at the top of Setup: company name, language, time zone and currency, email, invite colleagues, and whichever further steps fit. Each row links to its page and shows done from the real setting, not from a click.
- The time zone and currency dialog goes away. Those two become checklist rows, prefilled from the browser as today, and nothing is written until the administrator confirms.
- A deployment that never completes the rows still works. The checklist can be dismissed, and it is not shown to members.
- Language and country defaults follow the same offer, so they do not contradict the currency.
- 中国 is accepted in the country field, and its refusal text is localized.

The list of rows is for the dev to propose in the PR. #30125 rows 1 and 3 are covered here and should be closed against this card when it lands.
